name: uc41_display
notes: Universal Controller 4.1 (Tip Charger) display - do NOT flash onto a Plasma StandAlone panel. V4.1.38 + tip-sensor EMI filter (PA3 min-of-8 burst read, 3-tick debounce on fire/stop) + main-loop fixes (smoothed power/vac flow, timer shut-offs, stop from any screen, pump stays on mid-cycle); BENCH-TEST BUILD, not yet verified on hardware. On-screen version label still reads 4.1.38 (graphics unchanged). Program only (.4XE), uSD untouched (UNIVER~1.* or Universa.*). Flash over a direct 4D USB programmer.
